title: Fletcher Henderson takes Lester for four or five days
summary: Henderson hired Lester away in Little Rock, but Lester returned in days because Henderson's wife wanted a Hawkins sound.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: What was his position in the musicians' fraternity? Let's assume when he was with the Blue Devils, before he got to Basie. Was he already considered one of the great tenor players?
Even though he didn't sound like Hawk and didn't get that heavy sound and all that sort of stuff.
No. Fletcher Henderson stole him from us in Little Rock. He was gone about...
No. About four or five days and he was back.
Yes. If I'm not mistaken, I think what it was, Fletcher's wife got him, and she wanted him to sound like Hawk. And he said he couldn't do it, and he come on back to the band. We was in Little Rock.
